text:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming.sse.p99 latency > 10s for the last 5m (detected by grafana). linked runbook: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/streaming-p99. paging oncall. :rotating_light:

alex: seeing same in logs, p95 up to ~2.2s, p99 burst at ~12s. customers with long-lived SSE connections seeing trailing silence + reconnects.

maria: note: error rate is not elevated, just tail latency and socket stalls. poss related to proxy writeback/backpressure.

chen: @alex can you grab a recent trace for one of the affected request IDs? I want kernel/send queue metrics and proxy write latencies.

alex: pulling traces now. sample IDs: req_1024, req_2099, req_3072. grep from edge-proxy logs: `grep "req_1024" /var/log/proxy/* | tail -n 200`

alex: paste of relevant lines:
```
proxy-1 2026-03-15T18:02:13.123Z req_1024 chunk_send=0.002 write_wait=12003ms conn_state=backpressure
proxy-2 2026-03-15T18:02:13.456Z req_2099 chunk_send=0.001 write_wait=11500ms conn_state=ok
serve-3 2026-03-15T18:02:14.001Z req_3072 kv_cache_hit=true token_gen=0.020
```

jamal: write_wait ~12s on proxy when client isn't reading. indicates slow consumers or socket buffers blocked. Are we seeing client ack lag or TCP-level retransmits?

alex: tcpdump on proxy shows zero retransmits but long periods of zero traffic on SSE socket. clients not reading (or they're paused).

maria: this matches recent canary where we disabled aggressive keepalive for cost reasons. if sockets stay open but clients go idle, proxy ends up queueing chunks and blocks. Could be a regression from the proxy patch last night.

chen: rolling proxy config check: current keepalive: 120s, write_timeout: 30s, upstream_idle: 60s. The write_timeout seems too low to detect blocked clients? Wait config diff: last change bumped keepalive -> 600s and decreased write_timeout -> 10s. commit: d4a9f2.

jamal: so we increased keepalive, decreased write timeout — longer lived sockets but shorter write deadline => weird. That could cause write syscalls to block until timeout and then accumulate?

maria: mitigation plan: 1) enable short socket-level tcp_keepalive probes on streaming listeners; 2) temporarily increase proxy worker queue and fallback to smaller model variant for streaming to reduce chunk size; 3) re-enable earlier backpressure-friendly behavior.

alex: while we prepare config patch, enabling immediate mitigation: flip proxy feature flag to 'streaming-backpressure-relaxed' = false to use old behavior. command: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/edge-proxy STREAMING_BACKPRESSURE_RELAXED=false`

incident-bot: RUNBOOK STEP: If switching flag, monitor p99 for 5m and check SSE reconnect rate.

chen: I'm applying the flag now. output:
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: edge-proxy-config
data:
  STREAMING_BACKPRESSURE_RELAXED: "false"
EOF
```

chen: flag applied to canary pods, rolling to all. watching.

alex: after flag flip p99 dropped from 12s -> 3.1s on canary. reconnects down ~60%. watching global roll.

maria: customer impact: support ticket #8762 reports reconnects, mostly integrations with older SDKs. affected ~0.6% of active streaming sessions; severity = P2. please draft brief for trust & safety and support.

jamal: tracking note: this looks like a regression introduced by commit d4a9f2 (proxy keepalive bump). plan to revert or patch in prod after stabilization. creating issue and assignment.

alex: rolling to all proxies now (rolling update). command posted. expect 3-5m for full roll.

oncall: taking oncall handoff at 18:14UTC — will monitor for next 30m. @maria if we still see >5s p99 after full roll, escalate to infra leads.

maria: thanks. I'll prepare the customer-facing blurb: "We've observed intermittent streaming stalls caused by a proxy configuration change; we've rolled back the setting and streaming latency has improved. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and a timeline for fix."

incident-bot: NOTE: create post-incident ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-sre.

chen: logged ENG-5491: "proxy keepalive/regression — streaming stalls p99" with traces and config diffs.

jamal: follow-ups: 1) add smoke tests for idle-client chunk flush behavior, 2) re-evaluate keepalive default, 3) add metric for per-socket write queue length, 4) coordinate with support to contact top 3 affected customers.

oncall: handing off to night oncall @jamal_night at 18:40UTC. I'll leave watch for 2 hours. all clear so far on global after roll.

jamal: acknowledged. I'll check in 30m and open bridge if regressions return. good work team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: p99 back within SLO (5m stable). root cause pending postmortem.
